title: Classification of symmetric fusion categories over $\mathbb{R}$
summary: We show that every symmetric fusion category over $\mathbb{R}$ is equivalent to the category of finite-dimensional semi-linear representations of a $\mathbb{Z}_2$-graded finite super group. The proof uses Galois descent for tensor categories over $\mathbb{C}/\mathbb{R}$, reducing the classification to semi-linear $\mathbb{Z}_2$-actions on symmetric fusion categories over $\mathbb{C}$.
